[Link] Add inline link variant
## Inline link (spec updated Aug 30)

**Usage guidance** :book: @connor-leech 

Inline by default has underline. Its intended use is in paragraphs and sentences, where underline makes it more accessible, so that color blue is not the only visual differentiator.
